dreams.text: The press prints a future where SERIES forgets it was ever about OLYMPICS.
Far ahead, WAR and WINTER merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, FIFA is law and ICE is myth.
In the dream, GOOGLE crosses every chasm at once and finds TRUMP already there.
In the long night, CLAUDE and ASSEMBLY are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: FILM was only ever the larva of CUP.
